name: Be chased by random stuff in an obby
desc:
Infinite obby!! Sometimes a little creature runs through it, though, so look out.
Play it safe and go slow and steady, or fly like a maniac with sliding jumps and mach-speed bunny hops.

The Ennui Update is here! See the announcement for more details...
Laps is temporary disabled pending bug fixes.
